text: I think it's a combination of skill and attitude, but attitude is often underestimated. Two people can have exactly the same qualifications, yet the one who is curious, reliable and willing to learn from mistakes will usually go much further. Communication matters a lot as well. Even in very technical jobs, you need to explain problems clearly and work with other people, so social skills can make a real difference.

tips.en: Attitude is often underestimated states a view at once, with an unexpected focus.
tips.kk: Attitude is often underestimated — ұстаным бірден, күтпеген екпінмен.
tips.ru: Attitude is often underestimated — позиция сразу, с неожиданным акцентом.

tips.en: Same qualifications, yet … is an imagined example that makes the idea clear.
tips.kk: Same qualifications, yet … — болжамды мысал ойды көрнекі етеді.
tips.ru: Same qualifications, yet … — воображаемый пример делает мысль наглядной.
tips.example: Two people can have exactly the same qualifications

questions.followUp: Is talent more important than experience?
questions.question: What makes people good at their jobs?

text: Ideally both, but if I had to pick one, I'd lean towards a job you enjoy. You spend a huge part of your life at work, and doing something you hate every day can really wear you down, however good the salary is. That said, I can understand people who put money first, especially if they're supporting a family. For them, loving the job might be a luxury they can't afford.

tips.en: I'd lean towards makes a choice without sounding absolute.
tips.ru: I'd lean towards — выбор без категоричности.
tips.example: I'd lean towards a job you enjoy

tips.en: I can understand people who … is a mature concession.
tips.kk: I can understand people who … — парасатты мойындау.
tips.ru: I can understand people who … — зрелая уступка.
tips.example: I can understand people who put money first

note.en: “Make you tired and unhappy over time”.

note.ru: «Роскошь, которую они не могут себе позволить».

questions.question: Should people choose a job they love or a job that pays well?

text: Partly it's a question of tradition. For a long time, parents in my country pushed their children towards university and a desk job, because that was seen as the path to a better life. As a result, plumbers, builders and electricians were often looked down on, even though society can't function without them. Ironically, many of these workers now earn more than office staff, because there's such a shortage of them.

tips.en: Explaining through how things were for a long time gives depth.
tips.kk: Ұзақ уақыт қалай болғаны арқылы түсіндіру — жауап тереңірек.
tips.ru: Объяснение через то, как было долгое время, — ответ глубже.
tips.example: parents in my country pushed their children towards university and a desk job

tips.en: Ironically introduces a surprising fact at the end.
tips.ru: Ironically вводит неожиданный факт в конце.
tips.example: Ironically, many of these workers now earn more than office staff

questions.question: Why are some practical jobs less respected than office jobs?

text: I think it will take over a lot of routine tasks, like sorting documents, answering simple customer questions or writing basic reports. That could be worrying for some office workers in the short term. But in the long run, I suspect it will create new kinds of jobs too, just as computers did. The people who do best will probably be those who learn to use these tools rather than compete with them.

tips.en: In the short term … in the long run gives two time frames.
tips.kk: In the short term … in the long run — болжамның екі кезеңі.
tips.ru: In the short term … in the long run — два горизонта прогноза.
tips.example: But in the long run, I suspect it will create new kinds of jobs too

tips.en: Just as computers did compares with the past and makes the prediction stronger.
tips.kk: Just as computers did — өткенмен салыстыру болжамды сенімдірек етеді.
tips.ru: Just as computers did — сравнение с прошлым делает прогноз убедительнее.

questions.question: How will artificial intelligence change the jobs people do?

text: I don't think there's one right answer. Staying in one company can give you security and a deep understanding of how things work, which older generations valued a lot. On the other hand, changing jobs every few years helps you learn new skills and often leads to a higher salary. Personally, I'd say the key is to move for the right reasons, not just because you're bored for a few weeks.

tips.en: I don't think there's one right answer is an honest start to a debatable question.
tips.kk: I don't think there's one right answer — даулы сұраққа шынайы бастама.
tips.ru: I don't think there's one right answer — честное начало для спорного вопроса.
tips.example: I don't think there's one right answer

tips.en: The key is to … gives a practical conclusion.
tips.kk: The key is to … — практикалық қорытынды.
tips.ru: The key is to … — практичный вывод.
tips.example: the key is to move for the right reasons
